messages:
Lena (CSM): FYI flagged: AlloyRetail (mid-market). Onboarding stalled at 'integration tests' step. Weekly active seats down 35% vs baseline. Renewal in ~5 weeks. Thinking a targeted microtriage + soft off-ramp offer.
Ravi (AM): Thanks. Any product bugs or just UX friction?
Lena (CSM): Mostly confusion around deployment profiles and token costs. Two devs hit rate-limit errors during batch ingest. No legal/exec signals yet.
Cam (Success Eng): I can run a short diagnostics run (10-15m) to confirm queue sizes and retry policies. Might be misconfigured client-side batching.
Zoe (PS): I'll assemble a 20-min "get-through-step-3" workshop: config checklist, quick rollback steps, and a small script to normalize batch window. Recommend offering 1.5 hours of PS + $750 account credit to lower friction.
Ravi (AM): OK to approve credit. Let's keep the offer modest and time-boxed. Aim for first outreach within 36h.
Lena (CSM): Draft outreach (feel free to tweak):
```
Subject: Quick workshop to finish integration tests for AlloyRetail
Hi [Name],
Noticed your team hit a stop at integration tests. Can we schedule a 20-30 min workshop to run a diagnostics pass and walk through batch/integration configs? We'll include 1.5h of PS and a $750 credit to help with any immediate infra tuning.
Thanks,
Lena (CSM)
```
Cam (Success Eng): I'll attach a pre-call checklist: recent client logs, batch window settings, token-rate snapshots, and any custom client retry logic. Link (internal): https://redwood.internal/checks/onboard-quick-dx
Zoe (PS): Success criteria for the session: 1) integration tests pass locally for the dev team, 2) no rate-limit errors in next 48h, 3) seat activity improves by >=20% within 7 days. If criteria fail, we trigger downgrade-mitigation plan.
Lena (CSM): Proposed timeline: Day 0 outreach; Day 2 workshop; Day 3-6 PS/SE followups; Day 8 metrics check.
Ravi (AM): Who owns escalation if workshop doesn't move needle?
Cam (Success Eng): Cam owns diagnostics and immediate triage. Zoe owns PS remediation. Lena will own commercial follow-ups and decide on escalation to "high-touch retention".
ops-bot: Reminder set: follow-up metrics check in 8 days (1765567799). :calendar:
Lena (CSM): Also prepping a soft off-ramp option: 1) temporary usage cap raise for 2 weeks with prorated credit, 2) simplified integration template + dedicated office hours, 3) downgrade path mapping (feature parity vs lower tier). We'll only propose if workshop fails and exec signals cool off.
Zoe (PS): Can we pre-draft downgrade mapping doc? I'll add a compatibility table and migration steps.
Cam (Success Eng): I'll capture exact logs and a small mitigation patch we can apply as a canary. Keep it reversible.
Ravi (AM): Sounds good. Lena send outreach and loop exec sponsor. Report back once session complete.
Lena (CSM): Outreach sent at 10:12. Workshop booked for Wednesday 11:00. Will update thread after workshop with outcome + next steps. :thumbsup:
